title: A Makefile for CI
prompt:
CI needs one entry point. Add a `Makefile` with the targets `test` (runs the unit tests with
`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`), `lint` (byte-compiles every `.py` file under `app/` and `tests/` with
`python3 -m py_compile` and fails on a syntax error), `check` (lint then test) and `clean` (removes `__pycache__`
folders). Targets that are not files must be `.PHONY`, and `make` with no target runs `check`.
